profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at U.S. Bank
profile.geoLocationName: Monmouth Junction, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Developer/Team Leader in the IT industry with strong experience in building software applications using object oriented technologies. 
Experience working on different phases of development life cycle ranging from analysis, development, programming to deployment and maintenance. 
Proven ability to deliver high quality products under tight deadlines in fast paced financial environments.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for developing applications and providing support for web applications.
•	Working in Agile environment to ensure rapid software development and releases
•	Loan Servicing Quality Control applications
o	Designed technical architecture for the application with ASP.NET MVC, AngularJs, HTML5 and CSS3.
o	Worked in a team of 4 people, business analyst, team lead and a developer including me to complete the project on time.
•	Employee Performance Management Application
o	Responsible for leading EPM project
o	Designed the architecture as per the requirement of the application behavior
o	Worked in Agile fast paced development environment to complete the project on time
o	Developed the application with AngularJs for frontend, ASP.NET MVC Web APIs for backend, SQL as database
•	Working as a Lead Developer on employee performance management system to measure performance of the employee in US Bank mortgage service departments and teams
•	Responsible for data manipulation of employee’s daily work to prepare their scorecards and showing them on the dashboard.
•	Learning modern technologies and implementing architectures of the applications to build better applications
•	Responsible for developing services and implement them in applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying and support all kinds of web applications.
Responsible for developing web APIs to access contents on Swig4K media Sticks
Responsible for applying security mechanisms through AES encryption techniques
Responsible for handling product strategies to build a user friendly product and solution.
Responsible for assisting clients including client and customer communication
Participating in handling future strategies for company's product development

positions.title: Technical Team Lead
positions.description:
Designing and coding dynamic web pages using ASP. Net, C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS.
Part of the system design team for designing architecture and system models.
As a Team Leader, responsible for maintaining team of 12 members including designers, developers and testers.
Managing client communications for all projects.
Integrating 3rd party APIs and web services.
Part of UI designing team for developing UIs for the applications. Building UIs in HTMl and XAML.
Development and deployment of windows services for LDMS project.
Developing WCF services to provide services to cross platform applications.
Responsible for implementing Agile Methodologies in department.
Experience working with agile methodologies for fast implementation of projects.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
• Responsible for System and architecture design.
• Responsible for Unit Testing and Code Review of developed code.
• Responsible for client communication and training sessions.
• Plugin development for web applications. Also responsible for developing third party APIs and tools.
• Integrating third party APIs with the web applications.
• Developing dynamic reporting system for Lead Distribution and Management System (US based).
• Development of multi-threaded web applications.
• Responsible for designing and team handling for in-house Task Management System for maintaining tasks in department and for coordinating between design, development and testing department.
• Responsible for handling team of 6 members and providing proper guidance.
• Development of Web applications using ASP.NET 4.0, C#, HTML, jQuery, CSS 3.0, javascript and SQL server for maintaining Database.
• Responsible for developing database designs. Also responsible for normalization of the databases.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on new development of modules for and existing ERP system.
• Generating reports for the Magic Survey Tool (product of Webmyne Systems)
• Responsible for designing, developing and unit testing of the application.
• Responsible for providing training sessions and generating help guides.

Technology and tool(s): C#, .Net 3.5, VSS, HTML, CSS, Visual Studio 2008, SQL Server 2008 R2

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Designed and developed system for purchase module for an ERP system. Purchase module includes accessing inventory, Purchase order generation, Goods receipt note generation.
Responsible for converting business logic to SQL schema.

projects.title: SwigCinema
projects.description:
Swigcinema is solution for backend office management for Swig Media, LLC
Swigcinema also offers their clients back end administration portal for managing their video content on Swig Video Management Cloud. Swig Media offers video streaming and encoding services to their clients related to HLS streaming and MPEG DASH smooth streaming technologies. Swigcinema offers video ingestion tool to their clients to ingest their videos and to distribute their content on Swig4K device and mobile apps.

projects.title: Swig4K.com
projects.description:
Swig4K is eCommerce application designed for SWIG4K, The First Globally Networked UHD/4K OTT Media Stick. The android based device is capable for showing UHD/4K contents with patent pending streaming technologies of Swig Media, LLC division of Mirage Quest company.
The site offers product selling and information features. Site also offers information related to 4K and Swig 4K technologies.
